title: heze-devnet-3
announcements:
**Scope.** Next spec devnet on the **Heze** fork. Keeps everything from [heze-devnet-2](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/heze-devnet-2) ([EIP-7805 FOCIL](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805), EIP-8015, EIP-8365) and adds EIP-8198 (CL + EL): slots go from 12s to **9s** at the Heze fork.
Execution runs on ethrex `heze-devnet-3`; consensus clients (Lighthouse, Lodestar, Teku, Prysm) reuse their `heze-devnet-2` images, as the slot duration change is driven by config. 2 nodes per consensus client, 1600 validators.
[bogota-devnet-0](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-0) (EIP-8141) is kept on a separate devnet track.
